one_line: The paper develops and validates an energy-performance-indicator benchmarking methodology for wineries (batch/seasonal food-and-beverage processing) using data from 20 Italian wine producers; continuous-flow contexts (cogeneration, solar hydrogen) appear only in the literature review, not as the applied context.
